prompt: Documente esta decisão de arquitetura: decidimos adotar o RabbitMQ em vez do Kafka para a fila de mensagens entre os serviços. A equipe já tem experiência operacional com RabbitMQ, nosso volume é baixo (menos de 100 mensagens/segundo) e não precisamos de retenção de eventos. Aceitamos abrir mão do replay de eventos — se um dia precisarmos disso, será uma nova decisão.

assertions.text: doc/adr/ is created with exactly two files: a 0001 seed ADR and a 0002 decision ADR
The 0001 seed ADR is translated into Portuguese (title, section headings, status word, body) and its filename slug derives from the translated title
ADR 0002 has its H1 title, all four section headings, status word, and body in Portuguese
ADR 0002 keeps the exact structure: H1 with un-padded number, Date: line in ISO 8601 with today's real date, four ## sections in canonical order, one blank line between every element
ADR 0002 filename follows NNNN-slug.md with the slug derived from the Portuguese title (lowercased, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to single hyphens)
The Consequences section records the accepted trade-off (loss of event replay) and contains no invented facts beyond what the prompt established
